name: Command
description: A command palette / search interface built on the cmdk library. Provides a filterable list of options with keyboard navigation. Includes a CommandDialog variant that wraps Command inside a Dialog for modal usage. Sub-components provide structured input, list, grouping, items, separators, and keyboard shortcut display.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the root Command container.

props.name: filter
props.description: Custom filter function. Return 1 for match, 0 for no match.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value of the selected item.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when the selected item changes.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether keyboard navigation loops from last to first item and vice versa.

subComponents.name: CommandDialog
subComponents.description: A convenience wrapper that renders Command inside a Dialog with DialogContent. Accepts all DialogProps (open, onOpenChange, etc.). Content is styled with overflow-hidden and no padding.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the dialog.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the dialog open state changes.

props.name: children
props.description: Command sub-components (CommandInput, CommandList, etc.).

subComponents.name: CommandInput
subComponents.description: A search input field with a Search icon. Renders inside a bordered wrapper with the cmdk-input-wrapper attribute. Styled as h-10 with transparent background.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the search input.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: CommandList
subComponents.description: The scrollable container for command items. Max height is 300px with overflow-y-auto.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: CommandEmpty
subComponents.description: Content displayed when no results match the search query. Centered text with py-6.

props.name: children
props.description: The empty state message.

subComponents.name: CommandGroup
subComponents.description: Groups related command items under a heading. The heading is styled as text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground.

props.name: heading
props.description: The group heading text.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: CommandItem
subComponents.description: A selectable item in the command list. Highlights on selection with bg-accent. Supports disabled state.

props.name: value
props.description: The value used for filtering and selection.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Callback when the item is selected.

props.name: keywords
props.description: Additional search keywords to match against. Useful for alternate terms, translations, or synonyms that should trigger this item in search results.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the item, reducing opacity and preventing interaction.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: CommandSeparator
subComponents.description: A visual separator between command groups. Renders as a 1px horizontal line with bg-border.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

subComponents.name: CommandShortcut
subComponents.description: Displays a keyboard shortcut hint aligned to the right of a CommandItem. Styled as text-xs tracking-widest text-muted-foreground.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: children
props.description: The shortcut text, e.g., a key combination.

accessibility.role: The Command root uses role='listbox' semantics internally (via cmdk). CommandItems are role='option'. CommandInput is a standard text input.
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow Up/Down navigates between items. Enter selects the highlighted item. Escape closes the CommandDialog. Type to filter items. Home/End move to first/last item when loop is false.
accessibility.aria: aria-selected is set on the currently highlighted item. aria-disabled is set on disabled items. The input is associated with the listbox via aria-controls.
accessibility.notes: When used as CommandDialog, focus is trapped inside the dialog. The cmdk library handles all search filtering and keyboard navigation automatically.
